name: @emsenn/app-discord-steward
description: The parameterized, runnable form of @emsenn/organizing-with-discord: give it a server name, bot name, bot key, and admin username, and it runs an autonomous steward in that Discord server while measuring and de-enclosing the server within the section 12 automate/keep-human boundary.

x-agentic-metro-enterprise.admission: one explicit discord-steward CLI operation for a named Discord server using caller-supplied configuration and credentials
x-agentic-metro-enterprise.refusal: an unknown command, malformed configuration, a missing bot token for run, or a missing client ID for invite

run-discord-steward.configuration: optional --config and CLI overrides; DISCORD_BOT_TOKEN may supply the bot token
run-discord-steward.returns: a running Discord steward or a typed process refusal before gateway connection

invite-discord-steward.configuration: --client-id or DISCORD_CLIENT_ID with optional capability selection
invite-discord-steward.returns: a Discord OAuth2 invite URL or a refusal for a missing client ID

check-discord-steward-configuration.returns: a configuration, bot-token, and inference-endpoint presence report

scripts.check: pnpm run build:deps && pnpm run check:local
scripts.build: pnpm run build:deps && pnpm run build:local
scripts.rebuild: pnpm run clean && pnpm run build
